problem.title: Running Odoo is more than installing it.
problem.body: The work starts after the first install, when there are several clients, several versions and nobody watching the servers.
problem.p1.title: Every server by hand
problem.p1.body: Database, proxy, certificates and workers, set up again for every client and slightly differently each time.
problem.p2.title: You find out last
problem.p2.body: A backup that stopped weeks ago, a disk at 100%, production down. The first warning is the client calling.
problem.p3.title: Deploying is a risk
problem.p3.body: Modules copied over SSH, no staging to try them and logs scattered in files nobody can find.

asst.body: Dooservice Assistant is a chat in Odoo's Discuss. It explains how the company works, from the processes its consultants reviewed, and turns what someone wants to see into a request your team builds, reviews and deploys.
asst.p1.title: Ask how the company works
asst.p1.body: Who approves a discount, when an invoice goes out. The answer comes only from reviewed processes and says which steps it stands on. The AI sees no record.
asst.p2.title: Request in their own words
asst.p2.body: A list, a board or a report. Before sending, they see what was understood and on about how many records.
asst.p3.title: Built, reviewed, deployed
asst.p3.body: It is built on a development copy, as a pull request in your repository. You approve it in the panel and it arrives with the next deploy.
asst.p4.title: The project brain
asst.p4.body: Writes down how this company uses its Odoo from counts and settings, proposes improvements every week and turns what was made by hand into code.
asst.p5.title: Your AI account, your limit
asst.p5.body: Anthropic, OpenAI or a compatible service. Every call with its cost, and a monthly limit (100 US$ by default) that warns you at 80%.
asst.note: Requests need a GitHub repository connected to the project.

os.body: The images your servers run, the modules in your Odoo and the skills of the AI are public on GitHub. Read them, audit them, use them or improve them.

faq.title: Common questions.
faq.a1: Yes. You install the agent on your own VPS, wherever you rent it. The machine, the databases and the backups stay yours.
faq.q2: Which Odoo versions does it support?
faq.a2: Odoo 16, 17, 18, 19 and 20. Each environment picks its version, so a server can run several at once.
faq.q3: Do I need to know Docker or Linux?
faq.a3: No. The panel sets up the database, the configuration, the networking and the certificates. You pick a version and a name.
faq.q4: Can I deploy my own modules?
faq.a4: Yes. Connect a GitHub repository, with deploy keys and submodules, and deploy it to any environment.
faq.q5: What happens if a backup fails?
faq.a5: You get an email the same day, and another when it works again. Backups are scheduled and restored from the panel, and every week we check that one really restores. On a paid plan they are also kept off your server, at another provider, with a weekly one nobody can delete: the one that saves the day somebody deletes something they needed.
faq.q6: Is the AI in the console safe?
faq.a6: The AI reads freely, but changes data only through Odoo and, on production, asks for your confirmation before each change. Sessions close after 30 minutes idle; on production, after 10 idle and at most 30 minutes. Without a connected repository, it configures Odoo but does not create or change modules.
faq.q7: Can I use a machine on my own network?
faq.a7: Yes. A VPS, an office PC or Windows, where we set up WSL for you. And if you want that Odoo to answer from outside, you publish it with a switch: your machine reaches out to us, so there are no router settings to touch, and the traffic stays encrypted all the way to your server.
faq.a8: You, directly to your provider. The AI account belongs to your organization or to one project (Anthropic, OpenAI or a compatible service), never to Dooservice. The panel records each call with its estimated cost, and a monthly limit, 100 US$ by default, warns by email at 80% and stops the calls when it is reached.
